'''Selitan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Selitan system/Legends|Selitan system]]. It was situated in the [[Loop Worlds]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]] connected it to the [[Pinoora system/Legends|Pinoora]] and [[Tertiary Feswe system/Legends|Tertiary Feswe systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Selitan was a busy [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world virtually entirely controlled by conglomerates from the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]] world [[Hynah]]. It featured [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] and sportsplexes, and Selitani [[Miner/Legends|miners]] also frequently visited the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]] [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] world [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Junction]] for rest and relaxation.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Selitan was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-6.<ref name="TEA" />
